name: Wi-Fi Aware peer discovery
plain: Finds and talks to nearby devices directly over Wi-Fi, with no router.
meaning: A broad nearby radio. Android treats it as a nearby devices permission and iOS 26 adds a system pairing flow.

android.note: Needs hardware support; Android 16 adds ranging

ios.note: Supports the Wi-Fi Alliance spec; pairing handled by the system

limits.headline: Can find and talk to nearby devices directly over Wi-Fi, with no router
limits.user_action: You tap Allow for Nearby devices or approve pairing in the system sheet
can: Find nearby phones and gadgets directly
Pair through a system pairing screen on iPhone
Measure distance to a peer on Android 16
cannot: Work on phones without the hardware support
Use the feature on iPhone without Apple's Wi-Fi Aware entitlement
Find devices before you allow Nearby devices on Android
limits.differs: Android needs Nearby devices permission (13 and newer, location before). iPhone needs an Apple entitlement and uses a system pairing sheet.

story.what_it_is: Two phones find each other and talk directly over Wi-Fi, with no router.

marketing.name: Wi-Fi Aware
marketing.pitch: Android lets nearby devices find each other and share data over Wi-Fi without internet or an access point.

story.for_you: You may see a prompt to allow nearby devices. After that, two phones can swap files or play a game together with no router. It feels like sharing by magic, even on a plane.
story.for_makers: Makers get fast, offline sharing and local multiplayer. It can also be used to find people nearby and track the local area. Platforms gate it behind a nearby devices step.

use_cases.example: Two friends play a head to head game on a train with no signal.
A chat app sends messages through nearby phones in a crowd with no internet, like at a festival.
A file share app sends a big video to a nearby phone directly.
A classroom app links tablets to the teacher's device with no school Wi-Fi.
A device setup app finds a new gadget directly, with no network yet.
A tracker app could use it to spot who is nearby, which is why a prompt is needed.

story.android_note: Android treats it as a nearby devices permission and needs support from the phone's chip.
story.ios_note: iPhone 26 adds a system pairing flow for Wi-Fi Aware, so the person approves each device.
